correctness.rationale: The simple walk decomposes into independent iid parity streams, whose separate run-length compression exactly produces the non-backtracking process. The compressed cover stages have independent geometric waiting times, and conditional repeat counts are negative binomial. The finite CDF is obtained by inclusion–exclusion. Factorial moments show Gumbel convergence; an independent terminal geometric bound gives O(1/n) atom probabilities and an L1 bound on winner switching. Conditional triangular-array characteristic functions show Gaussian fine fluctuations, stably independent of the macro Gumbel limit. Uniformly integrable exponential tails establish the mean constant. The actual embedded standard-library checker passed 8,764 assertions; these do not replace the analytic proof.

originality.rationale: The 2022 motivating primary paper studies approximate or averaged first-passage and mean cover times on random regular/configuration-model networks, not exact balanced-biclique parity compression or the joint Gaussian-saving/Gumbel limit. Aldous–Fill supply the classical one-stream loopless and iid coupon collector laws, explicitly used but insufficient alone to deduce a coupling-specific, last-side-selected negative-binomial Gaussian with an independent Gumbel companion and constant-order mean savings. The derivation proves the additional structural coupling and anti-concentration step. Search produced no directly covering claim; this is best-knowledge rather than a certificate of priority.

value.rationale: Non-backtracking is a natural minimal-memory intervention in network exploration, and this exact graph family exposes a previously unquantified two-scale performance difference: unchanged O(n)-Gumbel cover fluctuations but growing O(log n) saved steps with independent O(sqrt(log n)) Gaussian noise. The result includes an intrinsic mean correction and a physically interpretable coordinate-wise coupling; it is not merely a recitation of single-collector expectation formulas. The limitation to balanced complete bipartite networks is essential.
